subject: Utility Street Opening Restoration Policy
overview: The Medford City Council met remotely and spent the majority of the meeting discussing utility street opening restoration standards and permit oversight with the city engineer, ultimately referring the matter to subcommittee. The Council also received an update on COVID-19 property tax relief extensions and approved a zoning subcommittee report regarding adult-use marijuana regulations.

items.title: Tribute to Former City Clerk Joe McGonigal
items.summary: The Council paid tribute to former City Clerk Joe McGonigal, who served from 1967 to 1996, and held a moment of silence in his memory.

items.title: Paper 20-314: Utility Street Opening Restoration and Permits
items.summary: The Council referred resolutions demanding curb-to-curb street repaving by utility companies and proposing neighborhood mitigation agreements to the Public Works Subcommittee after reviewing utility trenching and moratorium procedures with City Engineer Tim McGivern. The Council also passed a motion requesting the administration review street opening fees to consider funding additional inspection staff.

items.title: Papers 20-311 and 20-312: Resolutions Offered by Councilor Knight
items.summary: The Council voted to table two resolutions offered by Councilor Knight until the next meeting because technical issues interrupted his remote connection.

items.title: Paper 20-313: Condolence Resolution for Margaret Peggy Small
items.summary: The Council voted to dedicate the meeting and observe a moment of silence for long-time Medford resident and school employee Margaret "Peggy" Small following her passing.

items.title: Paper 20-315: Update on Executive Action for Tax Deadline Extensions
items.summary: Councilor Bears reported on executive actions extending real estate and personal property tax deadlines and exemption applications to June 1, 2020, as well as waiving late interest on water bills paid by June 30.

items.title: Report of Committee 20-042
items.summary: The Council voted to table the committee report for paper 20-042 until the next meeting.

items.title: Subcommittee Report on Adult-Use Marijuana Zoning (Papers 19-659 & 20-098)
items.summary: Vice President Caraviello reported on modifications to the draft adult-use marijuana ordinance, and the Council approved the April 8 Subcommittee on Zoning report.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The Council approved the meeting records of April 7, 2020.
